messages.text: Hi! How can I track my package?
Hello! I can help you track your package. Could you please provide your tracking number?
Thank you! Let me check that for you. Your package 12345-ABCDE is currently in transit and expected to arrive tomorrow by 5 PM.
I am an AI assistant and I do not have access to specific business hours information. As an AI, I am available 24/7 to help with general questions.
Can you help me with my order?
I would be happy to help you with your order! Could you please provide your order number so I can look up the details for you?
Perfect! I found your order ORDER-98765. It looks like it was shipped yesterday and should arrive within 2-3 business days.
